## Checks

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 pytest`
- [ ] `python tools/check_validation.py --check`
- [ ] New or changed method: primary paper cited, deviations explained in the module docstring, behavioural tests for its defining mechanism
- [ ] New learning claim: recipe fixed before running, three unused seeds, all outcomes kept (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No private details (host names, internal paths, credentials) and no lab-book content
